name: Optimize a page for AI answers
prompt: Optimize this article so ChatGPT and Perplexity cite it.
expected_behavior: Reads .agents/<productname>/product.md so the rewrite stays on-brand and accurate
Observes how answer engines currently answer the target query before rewriting
Writes a 40-60 word direct-answer paragraph to sit after the H1
Restructures prose into extractable formats where it aids comprehension
Returns before/after, an AEO scorecard, and engine-specific notes
Does not fabricate stats or sources

name: Answer density fix
prompt: The answer to this query is buried — fix it.
expected_behavior: Identifies the core question and moves the answer into the first 60 words
Adds a TL;DR/summary block near the top
Keeps the human reader's experience intact, not just machine extraction

name: Entity and citation readiness
prompt: Make this content more citation-worthy for AI.
expected_behavior: Defines key entities on first mention and makes relationships explicit
Adds specific numbers, dates, and named, attributable sources
Surfaces author expertise and last-updated signals
Flags any missing data as a placeholder rather than inventing it

name: Engine-specific optimization
prompt: We care most about Google AI Overviews — optimize for that.
expected_behavior: Tailors structure and schema/E-E-A-T emphasis to the priority engine
Notes how the changes help the chosen engine specifically
Still generalizes well to other answer engines
